name: My Offer
what you get: Market research, competitors and a clear offer for what you sell
prompt: Use offer-builder on my business: [what I sell, who buys it, my price].

name: 10 Ads in One Go
what you get: 10 ad scripts from 10 angles, ready for Reels or Facebook
prompt: Use breakthrough-ads to write 10 ad scripts for my offer. Write them in Taglish.

name: Product Poster
what you get: A 4:5 poster of your product, made with your ChatGPT
prompt: Use image-generation to make a 4:5 poster of [my product] with the words "[headline]".

name: Price Objection Replies
what you get: Replies for "mahal" and "pag-iisipan ko muna" you can send on Messenger
prompt: Use sales-objections: my customers say "mahal" and "pag-iisipan ko muna". Give me Messenger replies.

name: Follow-Up Messages
what you get: 3 follow-ups for people who asked the price and went quiet
prompt: Use sales-followup: write 3 follow-ups for inquiries who didn't reply after I sent the price.

name: 30-Day Content Plan
what you get: A month of posts with captions for your page
prompt: Use content-strategy and social-captions: plan 30 days of Facebook posts for my business, with captions.

name: 5 Reels Scripts
what you get: Short video scripts with hooks, ready to shoot
prompt: Use video-scripts: 5 Reels scripts about [topic], in Taglish, 30 seconds each.

name: Review Replies
what you get: Kind, professional replies to your Google and Facebook reviews
prompt: Use review-response-writer on these reviews: [paste the reviews].
